name: Prior Approval Supplement (major change)
definition: A change with substantial potential to have an adverse effect on the identity, strength, quality, purity, or potency of the product.

name: Changes Being Effected in 30 Days Supplement (moderate change)
definition: A change with moderate potential to have an adverse effect.

name: Changes Being Effected (immediate / CBE-0) Supplement (moderate change)
definition: A subset of moderate changes that FDA has determined may be distributed at the time FDA receives the supplement (labeled 'Supplement: Changes Being Effected'), with no standstill.

name: Annual Report (minor change)
definition: A change with minimal potential to have an adverse effect.

name: PQS-managed change (no filing / no reporting)
definition: A change with no potential to affect product quality that is managed entirely within the applicant's pharmaceutical quality system and change-control procedures, requiring no submission to FDA and no annual-report entry (e.g., purely administrative changes, or changes within pre-established conditions/ranges already approved).

name: Comparability Protocol (CP): reduced-reporting mechanism (FDA analogue to PACMP)
definition: A prospectively submitted and FDA-approved plan describing specific tests, studies, validation, and acceptance criteria for a defined future CMC change.

name: Minor variation Type IA (annual update / "Do-and-Document")
definition: A variation with only minimal or no impact on the quality, safety or efficacy of the product.

name: Minor variation Type IA requiring Immediate Notification (IA_IN)
definition: The subset of Type IA minor changes that, for continuous supervision of the product, must be notified immediately after the change is implemented rather than waiting for the annual update.

name: Minor variation Type IB (default; "Tell, Wait, Do")
definition: The catch-all minor category: any variation that is neither Type IA nor Type II nor an Extension.

name: Major variation Type II (Prior Approval)
definition: A variation (not an Extension) that may have a significant impact on the quality, safety or efficacy of the product.

name: Extension of a marketing authorisation (Annex I)
definition: A change listed in Annex I that is so substantial it is not handled as an ordinary variation but as an extension application: e.g., change/addition of an active substance, strength, pharmaceutical form or route of administration.

name: Post-Approval Change Management Protocol (additional regulatory tool)
definition: An optional two-step tool (ICH Q12-aligned) codified as an 'additional regulatory tool' under new Article 6a.

name: Recommendation on classification of an unforeseen variation (Article 5)
definition: A pre-submission mechanism distinct from a variation: where a change's classification is not provided for in the Regulation or guidelines, the holder may request a classification recommendation before submitting.

name: Annual strain update of human influenza / coronavirus vaccines (special prior-approval)
definition: A dedicated fast-track prior-approval procedure for CMC/composition changes to the active substance made for the annual update of human influenza or human coronavirus vaccines (the latter only after an EMA public announcement).

name: Type IA minor variation (do-and-tell / annual notification)
definition: A minor change with minimal or no impact on the quality, safety or efficacy of the product (e.g.

name: Type IA variation requiring Immediate Notification (Type IAIN)
definition: A subset of Type IA minor variations that the classification guideline flags for immediate notification: the change is implemented and then must be notified to the MHRA without delay (rather than held for the annual bundle), because timely knowledge of the change is important for supervision (e.g.

name: Type IB minor variation (notify-then-wait; DEFAULT category for unclassified changes)
definition: A minor variation that is neither a Type IA nor a Type II nor an extension.

name: Type II major variation (prior approval)
definition: A major change that may have a significant impact on the quality, safety or efficacy of the product and is not an extension (e.g.

name: Extension of the marketing authorisation (line extension: new/extended MA)
definition: A change so significant it cannot be handled as a variation and must be applied for as a line extension: changes to the active substance(s) (including a different salt/ester/isomer/derivative), or changes/additions of strength, pharmaceutical form, or route of administration.

name: 重大变更 Major change: Supplemental Application (补充申请)
definition: A change with potential material impact on safety, efficacy, or quality controllability;

name: 中等变更 Moderate change: Record-filing (备案)
definition: A change with moderate impact;

name: 微小变更 Minor change: Annual Report (年度报告)
definition: A change with minimal impact;

name: Major Variation
definition: A variation to a registered pharmaceutical finished product that may affect significantly and/or directly the aspects of quality, safety and efficacy and does not fall within the definition of a minor variation or a new registration (AVG Rev 2 §3.1).

name: Minor Variation – Prior Approval
definition: A variation in terms of administrative data and/or changes with minimal/no significant impact on efficacy, quality and safety that nonetheless requires the Drug Regulatory Authority to issue an approval before implementation (AVG Rev 2 §3.2, §4.2).

name: Minor Variation – Notification ('Do & Tell')
definition: A minor variation (administrative and/or minimal-impact) handled by notification under a 'Do & Tell' procedure: the MAH may implement the change and then notify the Drug Regulatory Authority, which acknowledges a valid notification;

name: Brazil (synthetic): Immediate implementation, no individual petition (HMP only)
definition: Post-approval change to a synthetic/semisynthetic medicine that ANVISA has pre-authorized for immediate implementation without any petition to the agency, provided all required proofs are attached to the company-held Product Change History (Histórico de Mudanças do Produto, HMP).

name: Brazil (synthetic): Immediate implementation with individual electronic petition
definition: Post-approval change pre-authorized for immediate implementation, but requiring an individual electronic petition (protocolo individual) filed with the specific subject code and all required proofs at/around the time of implementation.

name: Brazil (synthetic): Prior approval (aprovação prévia / procedimento ordinário)
definition: Post-approval change with higher potential impact on quality, safety or efficacy that must be filed as an individual petition and must await ANVISA's favorable manifestation before implementation.

name: Brazil (synthetic): Labeling/leaflet (bula/rotulagem) update notification
definition: Update of package leaflet (bula) or labeling (rotulagem) text consequent to an implemented post-approval change, submitted as an electronic notification.

name: Brazil (biological): Major quality change (alteração maior de qualidade)
definition: Post-approval change to a biological product with great potential to impact quality, safety or efficacy.

name: Brazil (biological): Moderate quality change (alteração moderada de qualidade)
definition: Biological-product post-approval change with moderate potential to impact quality, safety or efficacy;

name: Brazil (biological): Minor / no-impact quality change (implementação imediata + HMP)
definition: Biological-product post-approval change classified as minor (or without impact on quality, safety, efficacy).

name: Brazil (biological): Efficacy & safety changes (alterações de eficácia e segurança)
definition: Changes to a biological product affecting clinical use: safety, efficacy, posology and/or route/administration.

name: Mexico: Minor modification to registration conditions (MCRS menor)
definition: A Modificación a las Condiciones de Registro Sanitario that does not affect the product or its production process (e.g., administrative/documentary changes).

name: Mexico: Moderate modification to registration conditions (MCRS moderada)
definition: An MCRS that, without modifying the production process, has an effect on the product (e.g., shelf life, place of manufacture national/foreign, packaging).

name: Mexico: Major modification to registration conditions (MCRS mayor)
definition: An MCRS with significant impact on the product/process (including changes affecting pharmacokinetics), requiring full prior technical evaluation by COFEPRIS before it can take effect.

name: Mexico: Registration renewal (prórroga del registro sanitario)
definition: Five-yearly renewal of the sanitary registration;

name: Argentina: Modification requiring prior authorization (traditional/synthetic REM)
definition: Modification to a registered medicinal specialty (Registro de Especialidades Medicinales, REM) under the Decreto 150/92 regime that requires ANMAT authorization before implementation.

name: Argentina: Notification-type / informative modification (traditional/synthetic REM)
definition: Lower-impact modification to a registered medicinal specialty that may be notified (informative) rather than requiring prior ANMAT authorization;

name: Argentina: Biological products risk-based post-registration regime (Disp. ANMAT 4351/2026)
definition: New risk-based framework for presenting, evaluating and authorizing post-registration modifications of biological-origin medicinal specialties (biotech products, vaccines, hemoderivatives).

name: Minor variation to be reported subsequently - Type IA (annual/12-month notification)
definition: A minor variation with only minimal consequences for quality, safety or efficacy that fulfils all defined conditions.

name: Minor variation to be reported subsequently - Type IAIN (immediate notification)
definition: A minor variation of the IA category that Swissmedic requires to be reported immediately after implementation ('IN' = Immediate Notification), because it is needed for continuous supervision of the medicinal product.

name: Minor variation to be reported in advance - Type IB (60-day standstill / tacit approval)
definition: A minor variation that is neither a Type IA/IAIN nor a Type II nor an extension.

name: Major variation - Type II (prior approval)
definition: A variation that may have significant implications for the quality, safety or efficacy of the medicinal product and that is not an extension.

name: Extension of the authorisation (new authorisation procedure)
definition: A change classified as an extension of the marketing authorisation - the most far-reaching category - that must be approved by Swissmedic in a new authorisation procedure before implementation.

name: Other change / unforeseen variation (default classification)
definition: A change not listed in Annex 7 TPLRO.

name: Minor variation Type IA (annual notification: 'Do and Tell')
definition: Minor changes with minimal or no impact on quality, safety or efficacy that do not require prior approval before implementation.

name: Minor variation Type IA requiring Immediate Notification (Type IA_IN)
definition: A subset of Type IA minor changes that, because of their nature, must be notified to SFDA immediately rather than in the annual batch.

name: Minor variation Type IB ('Tell, Wait and Do')
definition: Minor variations that are neither classifiable as Type IA nor as major Type II.

name: Major variation Type II (prior approval)
definition: Major variations that may have a significant impact on the quality, safety or efficacy of the medicinal product.

name: Change requiring a new application (extension / not treatable as a variation)
definition: Changes so fundamental that they cannot be handled through the variation procedure and instead require a new marketing-authorization application.

name: Annual Notification
definition: Lowest-risk change;

name: Immediate Notification
definition: Low-risk change implemented and notified to WHO/PQT immediately after implementation.

name: Minor variation requiring prior approval
definition: Minor change that must be accepted by WHO/PQT before implementation.

name: Major variation
definition: Significant change with potential impact on quality/safety/efficacy;

name: Type IA minor variation ("Do and Tell" notification; quality annual notification = Type IAAN)
definition: Minor changes with minimal or no impact on quality, safety or efficacy that do NOT require prior approval.

name: Type IA_IN minor variation (immediate notification)
definition: Minor variation notified around implementation within a 47-working-day window, adapted from the EMA Type IA_IN category.

name: Type IB minor variation (default "tell, wait, then implement")
definition: Changes that may have a minor impact on overall safety, efficacy and quality.

name: Type II major variation / Prior Approval Amendment (PAA)
definition: Changes that could have a major impact on the overall safety, efficacy and quality of the product.

name: Extension (line-extension) application
definition: Changes that fundamentally alter the terms of the initial registration (e.g.

name: Certificate variation: Transfer of HCR/Applicant and Proprietary Name Change
definition: Administrative variations that require issuance of an amended registration certificate: change of a product's proprietary name and transfer of the Holder of the Certificate of Registration (ToHCR) / Transfer of Applicancy (TOA).

name: Z-code (unforeseen / unclassified change)
definition: Any unforeseen change not detailed in the annexures (e.g.

name: Reliance down-classification of RRA-approved changes (codes B.r.a / B.r.b / B.r.II)
definition: A reliance mechanism (draft quality Annexure B) allowing changes already submitted to / approved by a Recognised Regulatory Authority (RRA) through which the product was registered to be handled at a lower procedural tier in South Africa, provided 'sameness' is maintained: Type IA/IA_IN variations implementable at the RRA may be grouped and submitted as a single Type IA (B.r.a);

name: Editorial changes to the dossier (no separate filing)
definition: Purely editorial changes to the quality sections of the dossier need NOT be submitted as a separate variation;
